title: sohum.geoziptag.team_plan/1
description: The plan of one team in the shared register, as the console shows and changes it. team_id is the existing team's id. Members who signed in with SoHum inherit the plan; removing a member removes their entitlement at their next check (decided 2026-11-28). See docs/GEOZIPTAG_ENTITLEMENT_SHAPE.md.

team_name.description: The team's own name (an organisation, not a person).

member_count.description: Phones that joined. Left out when fewer than 10 (console rule: aggregates hide groups under 10).

entitlement_id.description: The entitlement that carries the plan.
